record.one_liner: HubSpot is a CRM and marketing/sales platform with a REST API for CRM objects and developer tooling.
record.auth_notes: OAuth for public apps; private app / static auth access tokens for single-account use (api_key). critic: confirmed; new developer-platform apps use static auth token or OAuth.
record.access_notes: critic: access confirmed self_serve_free. Standard HubSpot accounts can be free, and developer test accounts are free accounts (up to 10) that can host apps/tokens, with a 90-day trial of enterprise features on top. Free-portal private-app visibility reports on community forums are mixed, so some risk.
record.api_notes: All REST APIs available via private app access token or public app OAuth token; broad CRM object coverage.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict confirmed. Remote MCP requires new Developer Platform and a user-level OAuth app; legacy apps can no longer be created, so new builds use the developer platform (CLI-based).

evidence.quote: There are two ways to authenticate calls to HubSpot’s APIs: OAuth, and private app access tokens.
